name: PACE-Bench
intro: PACE 是一种代理能力评估代理框架，通过从非 agentic 原子评测实例中选择紧凑子集，低成本预测 SWE-bench、GAIA 等昂贵 Agent benchmark 的表现。论文中的具体代理基准 PACE-Bench 在 14 个模型、4 个目标 agentic benchmark 和 19 个非 agentic benchmark 上验证，可用于模型开发、选择和路由阶段的快速估计。
org: Carnegie Mellon University; Salesforce AI Research
build_method: 代理子集选择, 回归建模, 混合
metric: MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy
eval_feature: Agent能力预测, 低成本代理评测, 模型排序
scale: 4个目标agentic benchmark, 19个非agentic benchmark, 14个模型
build_method_en: Proxy subset selection, Regression Modeling, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Agent capability prediction, Low-cost proxy evaluation, Model ranking
intro_en: PACE is a proxy framework for agentic capability evaluation. It selects compact subsets from non-agentic atomic evaluation instances to predict performance on expensive agent benchmarks such as SWE-bench and GAIA. The paper's concrete proxy benchmark, PACE-Bench, is validated across 14 models, 4 target agentic benchmarks, and 19 non-agentic benchmarks for faster model development, selection, and routing.
scale_en: 4 target agentic benchmarks, 19 non-agentic benchmarks, 14 models
metric_en: MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy
